S049.name: Eating_Large_Amount
S049.description: Eating, in a discrete period of time, an amount of food that is definitely larger than what most individuals would eat in a similar period of time under similar circumstances.
examples: Eating more than 3-4 times the amount of a typical meal within 2 hours.
Continuously eating large amounts of high-calorie snacks in addition to main meals.
Eating enough to empty a significant portion of the refrigerator or pantry at once.
Eating clearly more food than others during the same period of time.

S050.name: Loss_of_Control
S050.description: A sense of lack of control over eating during the episode (e.g., a feeling that one cannot stop eating or control what or how much one is eating).
examples: A feeling that once I start eating, I cannot stop even if I want to.
Thinking 'I shouldn't eat any more' but mechanically continuing to eat.
A feeling of helplessness that I cannot decide for myself how much to eat.
Eating as if my body is being controlled by someone else.

S051.name: Rapid_Eating
S051.description: Eating much more rapidly than normal.
examples: Swallowing food without chewing it properly.
Eating continuously and rapidly to the point where it is difficult to breathe.
Eating so urgently that there is no time to taste the food.
Eating at a speed that surprises others.

S052.name: Eating_Until_Uncomfortably_Full
examples: Eating until the stomach feels distended to the point of bursting and pain.
Eating so much that it is difficult to even stand up or move.
Continuing to eat until feeling nauseous or like vomiting.
Unable to stop eating even though it is physically uncomfortable and painful.

S054.name: Eating_Alone_Due_to_Embarrassment
S054.description: Eating alone because of feeling embarrassed by how much one is eating.
examples: Eating only when alone because of fear that others will think strangely of the amount eaten.
Eating secretly after family members have gone to sleep.
Pretending to eat little in front of people, then binging when alone.
Locking the door or eating in a secret place like a car to avoid being seen eating.

S055.name: Negative_Affect_After_Binge
S055.description: Feeling disgusted with oneself, depressed, or very guilty afterward.
examples: Feeling unbearable disgust and self-loathing after binging.
Falling into extreme depression and self-criticism immediately after binging.
Feeling intense guilt and regret over the fact that I binged again.
Feeling shame that I am pathetic and have weak willpower after binging.

patient_info.stressor_event: Major change in responsibilities at work (e.g., promotion, demotion)
patient_info.stressor: When Roy was asked to serve as acting lead on the CNC line while being considered for a shift-supervisor role, his days became longer and less predictable, with more paperwork, apprentice problems, and pressure to prove he could keep production moving safely. Over the next 5 months, the late shifts and missed family dinners turned into private stops for large amounts of takeout or leftovers eaten quickly in his truck or workshop, after which he felt overfull and ashamed enough to hide the pattern from his wife and church friends. He still kept working and volunteering, but the episodes became frequent enough that his careful, disciplined self-image felt shaken. He finally accepted a referral to a psychiatrist through the plant’s employee assistance program after a routine occupational health visit led him to admit how out of control the eating had become.

S049.name: Eating_Large_Amount
S049.description: Eating, in a discrete period of time, an amount of food that is definitely larger than what most individuals would eat in a similar period of time under similar circumstances.
S049.manifestation: What brings me in is that after late shifts I’ll stop for takeout and end up eating two burgers, fries, a shake, and then still go home and clean out leftovers in the garage like it’s a second supper.

S050.name: Loss_of_Control
S050.description: A sense of lack of control over eating during the episode (e.g., a feeling that one cannot stop eating or control what or how much one is eating).
S050.manifestation: Once I start, it feels like the switch is flipped and even while I’m telling myself, 'Roy, shut the bag and go inside,' my hands just keep reaching for more.

S051.name: Rapid_Eating
S051.description: Eating much more rapidly than normal.
S051.manifestation: I eat so fast in my truck or out in the workshop that half the time I barely taste it, like I’m trying to get it down before somebody catches me.

S052.name: Eating_Until_Uncomfortably_Full
S052.manifestation: By the time I stop, my stomach is tight against my work pants and I’m sitting there leaned back, uncomfortable enough that I don’t want to move for a while.

S054.name: Eating_Alone_Due_to_Embarrassment
S054.description: Eating alone because of feeling embarrassed by how much one is eating.
S054.manifestation: I’ll act like I’m not that hungry at dinner with my wife, then later I’ll go out to the truck or wait until she’s busy because I’d be embarrassed for her to see how much I’m putting away.

S055.name: Negative_Affect_After_Binge
S055.description: Feeling disgusted with oneself, depressed, or very guilty afterward.
S055.manifestation: Afterward I feel ashamed and kind of disgusted with myself, because I’ve always thought of myself as disciplined and dependable, and this makes me feel like I’m sneaking around and letting myself down.

additional_requirement_1.name: Additional Requirement 1
additional_requirement_1.description: The binge eating occurs, on average, at least once a week for 3 months
additional_requirement_1.manifestation: For the past few months, there’s usually at least one night a week—and often two or three—where I end up doing this after a late shift or a rough day on the line.

functional_impairment.name: Functional Impairment
functional_impairment.manifestation: I’m still getting to work and keeping up with church, but I’ve been more withdrawn at home because I’m spending energy covering up where I stopped and why I’m not hungry for dinner.

duration.name: Duration
duration.manifestation: This has been going on for about five months, since I was put in the acting lead role on the CNC line.
